To help me understand the foundation we’re building on, what has been your primary athletic background up to this point in your life?
Options: [Team-based field sports that focus on tactical awareness and agility | Individual endurance-based pursuits like long-distance running or swimming | Power and explosive-based training like weightlifting or combat sports]
Team-based field sports that focus on tactical awareness and agility

When you are in the middle of a high-pressure competition, which of these mindsets best describes how you operate?
Options: [I thrive on the adrenaline of high-stakes, quick-decision moments, preferring to act on pure instinct. | I prefer a methodical, analytical approach, obsessing over the fine details and technical precision of my performance. | I am a grinder, focused on consistency and outlasting the opponent through sheer discipline and long-term preparation.]
I prefer a methodical, analytical approach, obsessing over the fine details and technical precision of my performance.

Looking ahead to your potential in high-performance sport, how would you prefer to structure your daily training intensity to maintain that competitive edge?
Options: [High-frequency technical sessions that prioritize mastery of complex movement patterns. | Strategic, low-volume intensity designed to maximize explosive efficiency and energy management. | A recovery-focused, science-driven routine that prioritizes longevity and sustained long-term progress.]
High-frequency technical sessions that prioritize mastery of complex movement patterns.

scouting_result.scout_verdict:
Your physical architecture at 175cm and 73kg is built for the sudden, violent release of energy required in sprints. Your background in team-based sports provided the foundational agility, but your focus on high-frequency technical sessions reveals the nature of your potential: a relentless pursuit of biomechanical perfection. At 26, you occupy the prime window to harness fast-twitch power. As you step into the blocks for The 2028 Games, your analytical focus becomes your asset. You are executing high-precision movement patterns that you have spent hours refining. In a discipline where victory is measured in thousandths of a second, your ability to break down mechanics will set you apart.

For the adaptive pathway, your technical precision is equally vital. Whether mastering the start or maintaining kinetic efficiency through the drive phase, your methodical approach ensures consistency across every training session. By applying your analytical mindset to the specific biomechanical adjustments required for ambulatory performance, you turn movement into a science. As you prepare for The 2028 Games, your dedication to iterating on your technique allows you to maximize output and maintain a competitive edge. This path offers a rigorous test of your ability to optimize your body's potential through deep, disciplined, and highly focused technical mastery.

Your mind craves the long-form complexity of the endurance landscape. This path shifts focus from the singular burst of a sprint to the tactical, analytical war of attrition found on the open road. Your background in field sports taught you to scan and react, but here, that same methodical mindset is channeled into power-to-weight efficiency and the mastery of pacing strategies that unfold over hours. As you prepare for The 2032 Games, your success will be defined by your capacity to manage energy and maintain technical precision under fatigue. By treating your cycling discipline as a science project, you transform into a calculating, relentless force.

In the adaptive pathway, your analytical strengths are applied to the intricate mechanics of handcycling. Here, the focus on aerodynamics and mechanical efficiency becomes paramount, mirroring the depth of the standing discipline. Your approach to low-volume, high-intensity training allows you to refine your power delivery through every rotation, ensuring that your energy management remains optimal throughout the duration of the race. As you look toward The 2032 Games, you will treat the course as a complex variable to be solved, utilizing your methodical preparation to master resistance and pacing. This pathway rewards your dedication to detail and your ability to sustain long-term progress, turning every endurance challenge into a masterclass of tactical execution.
